item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02920","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correct average expression 120/2 by dividing again, then states an unsupported final 15.","case2_error":"Uses 50 pages instead of 10 for the densely filled pages and incorrectly evaluates 50×5×30 as 750.","reason":"Case 1 miscalculates a correctly formed average; case 2 also forms the stamp subtotal using the wrong page count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02921","case1_error":"Equates the brother’s entire pre-purchase balance with Michael’s gift, then answers Michael’s initial money instead of the brother’s.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final 450 after correctly specifying revenue minus record costs; the formula yields 75.","reason":"Case 1 uses an erroneous relationship and targets the wrong person’s balance. Case 2 supplies an incorrect number after correct formulas.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02922","case1_error":"Uses the final 20 fish as the original tank count when calculating how many fish were caught.","case2_error":"Adds the six sold cows instead of subtracting them, producing 95 instead of 83.","reason":"Case 1 confuses initial and final quantities; case 2 reverses the effect of a removal.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02923","case1_error":"Correctly derives 12 per chair but contradicts that result with leading and concluding answers of 20.","case2_error":"Treats one student’s 105 pens as the entire pool, omitting multiplication by three before subtracting used pens.","reason":"Case 1 exhibits an answer conflict without a faulty derivation, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02924","case1_error":"Calculates all new-company earnings at the old salary, ignoring the 20% raise.","case2_error":"Uses one month’s raised earnings as the two-month total, omitting the first month’s earnings.","reason":"Case 1 omits a salary increase from the applicable rate; case 2 omits an entire month from the requested total.","judgment":"different"}]}
